_comment: Guard config for this skill deployment. The script ALSO enforces a hardcoded safety floor even if this file is missing or broken. JSON (not YAML) on purpose: the hook runs under bare system python with no third-party deps. See DESIGN.md.
_attestation_comment: Gives review_gate.py a door: denies shipping a skill whose hash-keyed full review has not passed. Narrow — silent unless the call really is a ship (a write into install_root, or a ship-shaped Bash command that names a skill or runs inside a skills_root). Fail-CLOSED on the ship path. Separately, the hardcoded FLOOR denies hand-writing any .review-attestation.json / .review-history.jsonl / .egress-lint-attestation.json: those have exactly one writer.
